svg.text: The twin's second build: a tetrahedron of four Ø200 µm PLA beads in the glass chamber
side view (mm from the pick-up trap) — each bead's path from the pick-up down onto the support
top view of the finished build (mm)
gaps between touching beads: 9 µm, 8 µm, 5 µm, 2 µm, 0 µm, 3 µm

Gor'kov force from the exact glass-chamber modes (10 tones, 4× holding drive), gravity, air drag; beads fuse where they first touch. Not modelled: scattering by the support and placed beads, streaming.
